source_artifact.content_excerpt: Capability vocabulary covers what local models are actually for (T2-F3-3). A model variant onboards via family inheritance, not 7 hand-authored cells (T2-F6-5). Registry rows carry cost/latency metadata so routing changes reprice the fleet (H-F4-9). CI runs Registry.validate on engine-registry.yaml (T2-F2-4). Stale entries warn at dispatch and fail in CI (T2-F3-8 + T1-F2-6, one mechanism). Offer/routing policy expressible as registry data, not resolver branches (T1-F4-2).
